Tomorrow on VSRF Live, we’re excited to welcome back our good friend, the brilliant Kevin McKernan. Kevin will join us to dig into the growing evidence of DNA contamination in the COVID mRNA shots, the suppressed Zervos Study, and Kevin’s recent paper with Dr. Jessica Rose that was targeted for censorship by an academic journal post-publication and peer review—all stark examples of stifled scientific debate when the data challenge the narrative.
In this episode, Kevin and Steve will unpack how truth-tellers are attacked, data is buried, and the real perpetrators of misinformation shift blame onto their critics. We’ll discuss the backlash against the new documentary “An Inconvenient Study” and what the Zervos Study truly reveals about vaccine safety data. We’ll also examine the ongoing media blackout on excess deaths and injury data, even as new studies continue to surface.
The more they cry “misinformation,” the clearer it becomes that they’re protecting the lie. Tomorrow, we’re cutting through the noise to question the spin, dig into the data, and uncover what’s really going on—live, unfiltered, and audience-driven.
